description: The member tags of one tag group, each joined to its catalog record — provider count, api count, tag quality band and composite. Use it to see what a group is actually made of before trusting the group as a market. Priced B1 (single-entity synthesis) — $0.01 per call under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. See apis://prices.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

slug.description: Tag group slug, as find_tag_groups returns it, e.g. "company".
